claim_ceiling: Reproducible numerical study of a declared Vicsek-model family; no biological, cognitive, agency, or natural-system claim
scientific_questions: How do global polar order, local order, interaction structure and cluster geometry co-vary as noise and density change?
Which apparent order transitions persist under finite-size scaling rather than one finite population?
How much do current-position and erratum-aligned next-position neighbour-time conventions change measured structure?
Can cluster-local order remain high while global order cancels across oppositely oriented clusters?
Which observations and sampling intervals are required to distinguish transient ordering from stationary collective structure?

source.title: Topology and geometry of clusters in the Vicsek model across scales

erratum.title: Erratum: Topology and geometry of clusters in the Vicsek model across scales
erratum.corrected_rule: The focal heading at t+dt is aligned using the neighbour set at predicted positions t+dt, while neighbour headings/velocities are taken from t.
erratum.effect: The erratum states that the corrected update leaves the published physical interpretation unchanged and yields results indistinguishable from a forward update. The backward update printed in the original paper yields different power-law scaling for average degree and average path length versus cluster mass.

reported_source_claims_to_reproduce_not_: At investigated critical-noise conditions, average degree increases polylogarithmically with cluster mass.
Average path-length scaling indicates a two-dimensional network structure.
Average clustering coefficient converges across investigated cluster sizes.
Cluster area grows approximately linearly with mass while perimeter grows more slowly.
admission_gates: Fetch exact source repository commit and release archive.
Record all scripts, code/data files, MATLAB version and dependencies.
Recover exact density, speed, box size, radius, noise, initialization and sampling-window settings.
Hash every source data file and record license/attribution.
Reproduce the erratum-aligned update convention before comparing cluster scaling.
Keep backward-update runs as a separately labelled sensitivity arm, not pooled with the corrected result.

implementation.noise_definition: angular_noise_width_rad is the full width of uniform[-eta/2,+eta/2]

design.trajectory_sampling: record fast metrics at every measured tick
design.full_topology_checkpoints: run full metrics at 10 equally spaced checkpoints in the measurement window
design.paired_update_rule_sensitivity: for selected design points, replay identical initial state and seed under CurrentPositionAlignment and NextPositionAlignment

independent_oli_extension.trajectory_sample_unit: one independent initialization seed and complete run; time steps are repeated measures, not independent samples

statistical_analysis.per_design_point: Report seed-level time-averaged observables, across-seed mean/median, dispersion, 95% confidence intervals, and all individual seed outcomes.
statistical_analysis.susceptibility: chi = N * Var_seed(P_bar), where P_bar is the per-run mean polar order over the registered stationary window.
statistical_analysis.critical_region: Identify candidate transition regions from finite-size behaviour of susceptibility and order distributions; do not hard-code a universal critical noise value.
distribution_checks: Test hysteresis with registered upward and downward noise sweeps before classifying a transition type.
Estimate scaling exponents only over declared cluster-size ranges with fit diagnostics and uncertainty intervals.
statistical_analysis.multiple_testing: Do not select a transition point or scaling exponent from a visually convenient plot without reporting the full grid and model-selection procedure.
statistical_analysis.confidence_intervals: Bootstrap over independent seed-level trajectory summaries, not frames, particles or connected components.

performance_track.policy: Correctness and scientific equivalence are gates before any performance claim.
performance_track.no_claim_before: Pinned-hardware runs and exact all-pairs parity checks.

anti_leakage_and_integrity: All time points, frames and checkpoints from one seed/configuration remain in one split.
Hold out entire particle counts and density/noise regions for generalization claims.
Never pool update rules or perception geometries without reporting them as explicit factors.
Use a sealed test grid for any learned parameter inference.
No test data may influence source preprocessing, hyperparameter tuning or the chosen transition/noise interval.
Keep full result arrays and raw per-seed outputs; aggregate figures are not a sufficient evidence receipt.

source_reference.title: Absence of O(2) symmetry in the Vicsek model

implementation_conventions: ArithmeticScalarMean (separate implementation required; never alias to atan2)
required_protocols: Metamorphic global rotation of positions+headings with identical seeds and noise stream, away from square-torus boundaries.
Adaptive global phase shift phi(t)=phi_bar-mean_i(theta_i(t)) applied to headings before every update, with target phases 0 and pi.
Exact source profile N=1600, L=8, speed 0.01, radius 0.1, dt 1, eta 0.75 and 10000 time steps, once exact seeds/averaging windows are recovered.
Keep current-position and next-position neighbour-time conventions as independent model tags.

minimal_control_expected.interpretation: Synthetic branch-cut known-truth unit control only; not a full source reproduction or collective dynamics result.

symmetry_and_angle_convention_challenge.statistical_rule: Do not pool outputs from different angle-mean conventions or adaptive phase protocols in one phase diagram.
